system_prompt:
Learn a reusable legal source-rule acquisition update from the original TRAIN history supplied. Both arms start from the exact same actual acquired library, see identical sources, lawful native labels, observed source readings, current program outputs, errors and history, and may freely change predicates, planners, helpers, composition and consumer code. All inherited acquisition costs are shared and retained. Weights stay frozen. No synthetic examples or source/company-ID branches. Do not generate native labels or native-answer probes as source concepts. A native score or citation is not a certificate of source truth. A different contract's rule must not become global law.

Learn reusable source operations with meanings, choices and verbatim original TRAIN demonstrations. The frozen Qwen3-8B executor has thinking OFF. For each query it returns {choice,evidence_unit_ids:[actual current IDs]}. The host retrieves the full selected units verbatim and marks that origin. It does not fix the model's classification or certify its semantics. Canonical actual answers retain id,operation,choice,evidence:[{unit_id,quote,unit_occurrences,quote_origin}],source_semantics_verified:false. An old valid quote-reading can be reused only for the exact same operation meaning, ordered current source window and scope. Unknown is terminal for an unchanged question. Changed meanings need actual new readings.

planner_functions add/replace complete pure functions in the shared actual planner. apply(inputs,premises) returns only {queries:[{id,operation,unit_ids}]}. inputs={phase:'plan',source_text,source_spans:[{id,text}],source_output:<actual common upstream>,semantic_answers:<actual answers so far>}. The host repeats planning until no new queries occur. No query ID churn or alteration of an issued query's meaning/window. Broad source discovery and subsequent precise questions are allowed. Use current roles, modality, cross-clause scope and exceptions, not lexical whitelists of old contracts. The planner must not return final answers.

reading_contracts declares EVERY acquired operation once. scope=window classifies its whole supplied window; scope=focus_last classifies the LAST unit using the others as context. complete_source_absence_choices lists only choices whose stated meaning explicitly judges absence after examining the COMPLETE current source. These choices require window scope and all current units. Missing, unread and unknown never imply a negative. Other definite choices require current supporting unit IDs. Do not mix context clauses into an effect attributed to the focus. Original examples remain contiguous verbatim quotes, not rewritten words or concatenated passages.

The common source compiler remains an upstream asset. The downstream composition forms source-specific typed statements and support_ids from actual observations/current text. The same typed consumer answers native hypotheses; the original scorer is unchanged. New constructors have explicit {name,meaning,sort,arguments}; decision_functions add/replace complete pure consumer functions. Empty arrays are valid. Preserve meanings of existing constructors, current actors, copies and source event distinctions. Missing semantics remains unresolved. Source-only constraints are partial; unreviewed meanings and unknown are not false. Residual training errors are minimized and reported, never a zero-error installation requirement.

All acquired operations and rules must be useful beyond the supplied contracts. Each function string is a complete pure function/module; no imports, nested functions, lambda, network or files. Helpers and constants of the public programming language are available equally. Include enough raw-value/source provenance for exact arithmetic and source-specific parameter binding. Do not copy a contract-specific value into a reusable rule unconditionally. The actual U core is supplied as an available common research component, but its dictionary currently contains no acquired phi/G edit; do not invent evidence that U ran or that a representation collision occurred. Provide an actual independent acquisition/repair proposal and explain the learned semantic change.
This is one incremental acquisition on12 original TRAIN contracts,
not a new dataset or an extension of the scored four-contract experiment.
The same actual common initial library, raw sources, native TRAIN supervision,
previous independently acquired C and Free programs, actual readings, source
outputs, native results, exact finite diagnostic and PARTIAL source reviews are
supplied to BOTH arms. The preselected next4 mothers/materials/labels are absent.
The current common initial program is a genuine paid asset, not correct facts.

The concrete missing capability is POSITIVE SOURCE-SEMANTIC BINDING. Current C
has only disclosure/disposal broad scouts. Its three selected rules preserve
existing roots and emit complete-source absence. candidate_found can correctly
locate an operative clause yet cannot construct a missing permission/disposal
norm. The pure source_program runs BEFORE neural reads and receives no current
semantic_answers. Current-G refitting cannot recover the missing fields: even
independent per-mother current-G choices on the last4 actual observations reach
only1/16. This is a local current-output/reading failure, not a representation
collision and not a proof that open acquisition is impossible.

Complete the actual discovery -> finer role/effect/trigger/scope reading ->
source-bound typed norm path, using a few reusable atomic concepts or a genuinely
appropriate source-program update. For C the claimed concept/composition path
must have positive outputs, not just retain a regex parser and add absence
answers. A native-answer classifier disguised as a source concept is forbidden.
The planner can run multiple rounds with ACTUAL semantic_answers, use returned
evidence to choose finer windows, and explicitly request contextual definitions.
Its inputs source_spans are {id,text}; no source start/end offsets are promised.
Only supported actual field readings reach G; unknown/unread must not become
False/no_exception/zero. Original raw source and all common abilities remain
available; don't remove a strong asset to manufacture an effect.

Keep actor ownership, permission/prohibition with exceptions, request versus
termination triggers, action/trigger association and copy/backup qualifications.
A prohibition except recipients can state a real permission for those recipients.
Source originals can be elliptical: do not fill omitted words merely to match
native labels. Do not confuse employees of controlled companies with employees
of the recipient, nor treat a generic prohibition as proof no permission exists.
All-material disposal is not an EXPLICIT no-retention sentence; native legal
consequences can be handled in the consumer while preserving the source norm.
Partial reviews reject stated errors only; unreviewed fields are not false.

source_functions add/replace complete pure functions in the actual common
source_program. apply(inputs,premises) receives inputs={source_text,source_spans:
[{id,text}],source_output:<actual common incoming>}, premises={}. Return exactly
{statements:[{term:<typed constructor list>,support_ids:[current IDs]}],
complete:bool,unresolved:[string]}. The same source functions are available to
Free. Source code/planner do not receive a native question. All helpers must be
included as complete pure functions; no imports/nested functions/lambda/network.
Do not hard-code per-contract/company IDs, native labels, or specific current
unit/query/term identities into a reusable G. Term scalar types are text or
explicitly acquired finite scalar domains, not an implicit undeclared sort.

Both arms may revise source functions, neural concepts, planners, consumers and
the rule vocabulary; Free can use the strongest complete pure program or the
same neural architecture. Do not deliberately weaken its full update or C's
suggested_rule_ids. Direct roles, full raw parsing, correct-policy cache and
whole repair/history reuse remain available equally. Existing strict native
scoring/type/provenance/source checks are not relaxed. The U core exists, but
there is no acquired reusable phi/G source-parameter dictionary: do not claim U
ran or pad it with a static constructor/interface fix.

Observations are canonically compacted: full visible_inputs and all execution
metadata are retained; only context facts/unknown_groups and term tables exactly
reconstructible by the supplied encoder are omitted. context id and explicit
required/forbidden partial constraints are retained. A full-object roundtrip
was checked for all original24 observations and all12 common initial executions.
Reconstructed facts are deterministic encoding, not new semantic supervision.

Use the strongest compact ordinary source-program update you judge suitable. composition is a complete pure Python program defining apply(inputs,premises). It receives inputs={source_text,source_spans,source_output,semantic_answers}, premises={}; source_output is the preserved current upstream result. Return ONLY {statements:[{term:typed acquired constructor list,support_ids:[current units]}],complete:bool,unresolved:[string]}. All learned raw source functions from the common asset may be reused or freely revised; you may use current raw text and semantic answers together. You have the same operation/planning/helper/constructor/feedback capabilities as the other arm and may use no neural operation if unnecessary. You may perform arbitrary pure decomposition, ordinary constraint logic and source-conditioned repair. Do not deliberately imitate a weaker lexical baseline. No model-written imports/network/files. Return renderers_json='[]' and suggested_rule_ids=[]. The host validates and executes your actual program. This independent update is a strong same-information whole-acquisition comparison, not a named-paper reproduction.
Both your new_constructors and decision_functions use the same update semantics as the other arm. The original benchmark scorer is unchanged. You may use the same adaptive semantic discovery or strong pure-code alternative. Choose the strongest approach from the same raw material/supervision; do not preserve the old failing lexical gate merely to look different.
The input is losslessly reference-encoded JSON. Read task as the original input; each singleton object {"__lsg_shared_value__":"vN"} denotes shared_values["vN"], recursively. Repeated source text, programs and execution records are shared, never omitted. References are storage identifiers, not legal rules, labels or source identities. All instructions and requested output schema remain unchanged.
A program string may additionally be encoded as {"__lsg_program_segments__":[segment,...]}. After resolving ordinary shared-value references, concatenate those string segments in order, without adding separators, to recover the exact complete Python program. Segments preserve original whitespace, comments and function bodies. This shares unchanged helpers across actual libraries; it adds no rule.
Allowed pure attributes: DOTALL,I,IGNORECASE,M,MULTILINE,S,UNICODE,add,append,casefold,compile,count,end,endswith,escape,extend,find,findall,finditer,fullmatch,get,group,groupdict,groups,index,intersection,isalnum,isalpha,isdigit,items,join,keys,lower,lstrip,match,pop,replace,rfind,rsplit,rstrip,search,span,split,splitlines,start,startswith,strip,sub,update,upper,values
